questions.question: Describe thin-film solar PV material and their advantages and disadvantages.
questions.solution_html:
• Thin-film solar photovoltaic (PV) -2
  • Advantages: any three – 1.5
  • Disadvantages: any three – 1.5
  • Thin-film solar photovoltaic (PV) materials are semiconductor materials deposited in
  • very thin layers onto substrates such as glass, metal, or plastic. Unlike conventional
  • crystalline silicon solar cells, thin -film solar cells use much less semiconductor
  • material, making them lightweight and flexible.
  • Advantages: Lightweight, flexible, lower manufacturing cost, better performance in
  • low light
  • Disadvantages: Lower efficiency, larger installation area required, shorter lifespan,
  • lower energy density
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe the safety precautions that should be followed during solar panel installation.
questions.solution_html:
• Any five safety precautions – (5 marks)
  • Use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
  • Isolate electrical circuits
  • Handle solar panels carefully
  • Avoid working in adverse weather
  • Ensure proper earthing (grounding)
  • Use proper wiring practices
  • Maintain safe working area
  • Inspect roof strength

questions.question: Explain the role of an inverter in a solar PV system.
questions.solution_html:
• Brief explanation: (5 marks)
  • The inverter acts as the heart of a solar PV system, converting DC power into usable
  • AC power, maximizing energy extraction through MPPT, ensuring safe operation, and
  • enabling efficient utilization of solar energy in homes, industries, and grid -connected
  • applications.

questions.question: How does real-time monitoring benefit solar PV system performance?
questions.solution_html:
• Brief explanation: (5 marks)
  • Real-time monitoring enhances solar PV system performance by detecting faults early,
  • improving efficiency, reducing maintenance costs, increasing energy generation, and
  • enabling remote supervision. It plays a crucial role in ensuring the reliable and efficient
  • operation of solar power systems.
